title: Hammer curl
camera: Side view of the working arm, figure facing right

poses.label: Setup
poses.description: Stand tall with a dumbbell beside your thigh and your palm facing inward.

poses.label: Lift
poses.description: Bend your elbow to lift the dumbbell, keeping your palm inward and your upper arm beside your ribs.

poses.label: Top
poses.description: Finish the curl with your thumb up and your wrist straight.

poses.label: Lower
poses.description: Lower slowly until your arm is long, keeping the same grip.

review.checked_by: Codex (poses); Claude (pose review and in-app checks)
checks: Neutral grip stays fixed through all poses and transitions, matching the ThoeneFit cue and ACE guidance.
Upper arm stays alongside the torso as the elbow bends.
Wrist stays in line with the forearm as the torso stays upright.
The weight lowers along the same path on return.

Claude review: checked against the ACE hammer curl page (neutral grip, dumbbell rising to near the front of the shoulder, full return); poses unchanged. In the app it plays, steps and fits at 320px and 402px.
limitations: Side view shows one working arm. Repeat on the other side as described in the written cue.

source.artwork: Original. Drawn in code from the shared rig in web/js/guides.js; no third-party images or generated frames.
